context: Kenji visits Saito for an annual checkup.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 田中さん、体調、特に問題ないですよ。
lines.en: Your health is looking good, Tanaka-san. No concerns at all.
lines.style: Warm, steady delivery of good news. Clear and direct, but softened by genuine care underneath. The reassurance of a doctor who has looked at the results and is relieved to report well.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。仕事、相変わらず、忙しくて。
lines.en: Thank you, doctor. Work's been relentless as always.
lines.style: Grateful but slightly weary. A tired smile in the voice. He's sharing the weight of it without asking her to fix it — just acknowledgment between two people who understand.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: お仕事は、無理しないこと。それが、一番。
lines.en: Work—don't push yourself too hard. That matters most.
lines.style: Gentle firmness. A small pause after the first phrase. She's not lecturing; she's offering something earned from experience. The kind of advice a good doctor gives because she's seen what happens when people don't listen.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: I will. I'll be more careful.
lines.style: Sincere acknowledgment. He's taking her seriously — not just humoring the doctor, but actually hearing her. Quiet respect in the tone.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ご家族にも、よろしくね。
lines.en: Take care of yourself. And give my regards to your family.
lines.style: Warm closing. She's stepping back into professional warmth, but it's genuine—not performed. The kind of thing she means, said as she's seeing him to the door.
